name: Tavily Search

authConfig.label: Tavily API Key

name: Calculator
description: Perform simple and complex mathematical calculations.

name: DuckDuckGo Search
description: Free web search (DuckDuckGo) with no API key required. Uses the project's own SearchRuntime to answer questions about current events, documentation and general research.

name: Knowledge Engine
description: Universal knowledge engine with factual verification. Searches multiple sources, detects contradictions between independent domains and returns evidence with numbered citations [1], [2]... plus an optional concise answer in Spanish citing those sources. No API key required.

name: Image Generator
description: Local image generator powered by ComfyUI (Stable Diffusion, no API key required). Takes a detailed prompt and returns a generated image that renders in the chat. Generation takes 1-5 minutes on CPU. Requires ComfyUI running.

name: Video Generator
description: Local video generator powered by ComfyUI (AnimateDiff/SVD, no API key required). Takes a detailed prompt and returns a short animated video that renders in the chat. Generation takes 3-10 minutes on CPU. Requires ComfyUI running.

name: Image Analyzer
description: Analyze images using a vision LLM (MiniCPM-V/LLaVA via Ollama). Can describe images, read text (OCR), identify objects, interpret charts and diagrams. No API key required.

name: Ask User
description: Let the agent pause mid-run to ask you a clarifying question and wait for your answer.

name: Browser
description: Open a real web browser (Playwright/Chromium), navigate URLs, search with DuckDuckGo, and extract page content. Ideal for web research, verification and live data retrieval.

name: Filesystem
description: Read, write, create, list and delete files and directories on the local machine. Use for creating project files, reading configs, and managing local data.

name: Computer Control
description: Control the desktop: take screenshots, open File Explorer, launch apps (Notepad, Chrome, Paint, Calculator), list windows, click, type, press keys, and manage the clipboard.

name: Stable Diffusion
description: Generate photo-realistic images given any text input.

authConfig.label: Your Stable Diffusion WebUI API URL
authConfig.description: You need to provide the URL of your Stable Diffusion WebUI API. For instructions on how to obtain this, see Our Docs.
